decisions.reason: As the flagship product line closely aligned with the firm's digital direction, it remains a valuable option and is kept.
The continuing education institute is non-core and likely requires ongoing investment, so the firm drops this option to release resources.
This low-cost remote support tool complements existing software and is kept as a cheap option while its value becomes clearer.
The analytics dashboard aligns with the firm's digital strategy and retains option value, so it is kept.
The complete practice bundle is close to the established offer and presents little uncertainty, so it is kept.
The job and practice listing portal is distant from the core software and its option value likely has not materialized, so the firm drops it.
